name: Breadcrumb
summary: Trail showing the current location in a hierarchy.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail, in order. An item with no href renders as a <strong> carrying aria-current="page" instead of a link — the last crumb is where you already are, and a link to the current page is one more thing to skip.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the <nav>. Two navigation landmarks sharing a name fail axe.
